# Guard against the export race seen after the 2026-09-03 paris reboot:
# if this pod starts before Talos has mounted the e-media volume at
# /var/mnt/media, nfsd caches its fsid=0 pseudo-root against the empty
# mountpoint. Every client mount then fails immediately with
# "NFS4: Couldn't follow remote path" while the pod still looks healthy,
# and only a pod restart clears it (exportfs -ra does not).
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if [ -d /mnt/media/backups ] && [ -d /mnt/media/kopiur ]; then
    echo "media volume is mounted, proceeding"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "waiting for /var/mnt/media to be mounted ($i/60)"
  sleep 2
done
echo "media volume still not mounted after 120s; refusing to export" >&2
exit 1
Kubernetes cluster Dockerhub rate limit risk
Container {{ $labels.container }} in pod {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }} has been OOMKilled {{ $value }} times in the last 10 minutes.

set -euo pipefail
# Hourly dump into a temp file, checked before it replaces anything, so a failed or
# truncated dump can never overwrite a good one. One file per weekday keeps seven
# days of history; postgres17-cluster.dump.gz stays the latest (restore.yaml uses it).
out="/backup/postgres17-cluster-$(date +%a).dump.gz"
pg_dumpall -U "$PGUSER" | gzip > "$out.tmp"
gzip -t "$out.tmp"
mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
cp "$out" /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz.tmp
mv /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz.tmp /backup/postgres17-cluster.dump.gz

SERVE_PID=$!
sleep 5
ollama pull nomic-embed-text
kill $SERVE_PID 2>/dev/null
exit 0
